result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant name and one partially cut-off restaurant card in the horizontal scroll section.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section shows a truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' — the full name is cut off due to the card being partially out of the viewport without a clear visual affordance that it's scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant names wrap or truncate with an ellipsis properly, and add a visible scroll indicator or partial card peek to signal horizontal scrollability to users.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off mid-image at the bottom of the screen with no restaurant name or details visible, making it unclear what the item is.
issues.suggestion: Show at least a portion of the restaurant name/details below the image even when partially scrolled, or adjust card height so minimal metadata is always visible.
